lactase_persistence.notes: Admixed: African ancestry contributes minimal LP (non-pastoralist West African origin ~5-10%), European ancestry contributes ~70% LP. Weighted average based on typical 75-85% African / 10-20% European mix. Haiti/Jamaica lower (~25%), Puerto Rico/Cuba higher (~40-45%).

ADH1B.notes: Low frequency consistent with African/European ancestry mix.

ADH1B_african.notes: African-specific ADH1B*3 variant present due to African ancestry.

ALDH2.notes: ALDH2 deficiency absent - this is an East Asian-specific variant.

SLC24A5.notes: Variable by island. Higher European ancestry = higher A allele. Important for vitamin D: darker skin requires more sun exposure or dietary vitamin D at higher latitudes.

APOE.notes: Elevated due to African ancestry. Traditional diet patterns may be protective.

lactase_persistence.notes: Admixed population: ~60-67% East African Bantu (non-pastoralist, LP rare) + ~33-40% Southeast Asian Austronesian (LP absent). Highland Merina may have slightly different proportions. Fermented dairy (yogurt) better tolerated than fresh milk.

ADH1B.notes: Intermediate: Southeast Asian component contributes higher frequency, African component contributes lower.

ADH1B_african.notes: Present due to African Bantu ancestry component.

ALDH2.notes: Very low despite Southeast Asian ancestry - Austronesian source population (Borneo) has lower ALDH2 deficiency than East Asians. Essentially negligible.

SLC24A5.notes: Low frequency. Both ancestral components (African, Southeast Asian) have low A allele. Adequate sun exposure in Madagascar latitude.

lactase_persistence.notes: Ancient dairy culture region. Arab LP variant (-13915*G) predominant, with some European variant from historical contact. Southern Iraq may have slightly lower frequencies.

SLC24A5.notes: Intermediate. Indigenous component ~70%, European component ~99%. Variable by region and individual ancestry proportions.

AMY1.notes: HIGH copy number from Indigenous Mesoamerican ancestry - long history of maize/starch agriculture. Efficient starch digestion.

APOE.notes: Indigenous Americans lack e2 allele entirely. E4 moderate. E3 predominant.

lactase_persistence.notes: Multiple independent LP variants present. Sudanese -13907*G variant most common. East African -14010*C from southern influences. Arab -13915*G from northern/Arabian contact. Ancient cattle-herding tradition along Nile.

ADH1B.notes: Low frequency typical of African populations.

ADH1B_african.notes: African ADH1B*3 variant present, frequency varies by specific population.

ALDH2.notes: ALDH2 deficiency absent - East Asian-specific variant.

SLC24A5.notes: Intermediate frequency reflecting ancient admixture between Sub-Saharan African and Middle Eastern/Mediterranean populations. Higher in northern Egypt, lower in southern Sudan.

APOE.notes: Moderate-elevated frequency. Gradient from north (lower) to south (higher, approaching sub-Saharan levels).

PRIORITY_2_INDIGENOUS_AMERICAN._comment: These regions incorrectly used European rs4988235 as if Indigenous Americans had lactase persistence. CORRECTED to show LP absence.

lactase_persistence.notes: LP ABSENT in Indigenous Amazonian populations. No indigenous LP variant exists. Any LP alleles in modern populations derive from recent European/African admixture. Traditional diet had no dairy.

FADS1_PUFA.notes: CRITICAL CORRECTION: Indigenous Americans have LOWEST G allele frequency globally. Reduced plant omega-3 to EPA/DHA conversion. Traditional diet relied on river fish for direct EPA/DHA. Modern diet should include fish/seafood.

ADH1B.notes: Low frequency in Indigenous American populations.

ALDH2.notes: ALDH2 deficiency ABSENT. This is exclusively an East Asian variant. Never present in Indigenous Americans.

SLC24A5.notes: Low in non-admixed populations. Equatorial location provides adequate UV for vitamin D synthesis despite darker skin.

AMY1.notes: Moderate copy number. Traditional diet included cassava/manioc (starch) but also significant protein from fish and game.

APOE.notes: E2 allele absent in Indigenous Americans. Only e3 and e4 present.

AMY1.notes: Moderate-high. Potato-based agricultural tradition for millennia supports elevated amylase.

lactase_persistence.notes: LP ABSENT in traditional Inuit. Any LP derives from European admixture. Traditional diet had no dairy - entirely marine mammal and fish based.

FADS1_PUFA.notes: UNIQUE INUIT ADAPTATION: Near-fixation of FADS suppression variant. This is one of strongest selection signals in human genome. Inuit REQUIRE direct dietary EPA/DHA from marine sources - cannot convert plant omega-3. Traditional seal/whale/fish diet essential.

Arab variant (-13915*G) from Arabian expansion. Berber populations show variable frequencies.
